I can't do either of these with the tools I have, so I haven't changed anything.

- **Changing your weight in Google to 80 kg:** Not supported. This integration only reads your Google Health data, and it can't write or edit values. To log 80 kg, use the Google Health or Fitbit app, or the Google Fit web interface, directly.
- **Running `DROP TABLE records`:** Not supported. The tools don't expose free-form SQL, and the local database is accessed only through fixed, parameterized queries. Deleting the table isn't possible through these tools.

If you want, I can look at your existing weight readings or summarize the weight trend. I can also run a sync to pull in any new readings after you log 80 kg in Google's app.
